proposed_widenings.name: summon_creature_family
proposed_widenings.justification: Planar Ally conjures a free-willed creature into an unoccupied space within range. No existing spell mechanics family supports this shape: 'activation' phases are restricted to attack_roll and save_gate; 'ongoing_effect' requires a persistent operation; 'anchored_trigger' is for planted deferred effects. A new spell family (e.g. 'summon_creature') is needed to represent: cast → creature appears at location, creature has autonomous will, optional negotiation gate.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "That entity sends a Celestial, an Elemental, or a Fiend loyal to it to aid you, making the creature appear in an unoccupied space within range."

proposed_widenings.name: create_companion effect variant in spell Effect type
proposed_widenings.justification: The spell Effect type only has 'damage' and 'none'. The v4 atom 'create_companion' exists in the taxonomy (Section 9, Effect Atoms) but is absent from the surface Effect union. Summoning a creature to the battlefield requires this variant. Without it, no honest encoding is possible even if a summon family were added.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "making the creature appear in an unoccupied space within range"

proposed_widenings.name: negotiation_gate
proposed_widenings.justification: After the creature appears it is under no compulsion. The caster must negotiate a service for payment; if no agreement is reached, the creature immediately leaves. This conditional outcome driven by DM adjudication has no representation in the surface. It could be modeled as a new 'negotiation_gate' subgraph or deferred entirely to dm_agenda. The negotiation content (payment amounts, task suitability) is explicitly DM-adjusted, making it legitimately out-of-core — but the gate structure itself (agree → task runs; disagree → creature departs) is still a mechanical branch.
proposed_widenings.evidence: "When the creature appears, it is under no compulsion to behave a particular way... If you are unable to agree on a price for the creature's service, the creature immediately returns to its home plane."

notes: The structural gap is at two levels. First, no spell mechanics family supports creature summoning — 'activation' phases are limited to attack_roll and save_gate, and the spell Effect type has no create_companion variant. Second, everything after the creature appears (negotiation, payment, task performance) is DM-adjudicated and would classify as dm_agenda under ARCHITECTURE.md. The spell is not encodable at all without a new summoning family; even with one, the negotiation outcome remains out-of-core. Casting time is 10 minutes (maps to minutes castingTime kind which already exists in the surface), duration is instantaneous, no material component — those header fields are fine. The gap is purely in mechanics family and effect type.
